quickAccessFolders.description: Contains a list of folders to create and add to the quick access section of the file explorer.

settingsPaths.description: Contains a list of application settings mappings.

items.description: Defines a source-destination mapping of a resource located in the `app-settings` folder.

resourceName.description: The name of the file or directory.

destination.description: The destination path. It must be an absolute path.

completionCommands.description: Commands to execute after copying the resource.

items.description: Contains a list of command arguments, e.g: ["echo", "Hello World!"]

postInstallationInstructions.description: Post-installation instructions to be displayed at the end of the installation process.

vscodeExtensions.description: Contains a list of VSCode extensions to install.
